# Alec & Alonzo

- [Alec](../character/alec.md) — Rival of — [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) — suitors competing for Phil Gordon's hand · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> During her stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace and meets the woman currently living there. The woman allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to explore the house, including the room where she was born, and hands over a small packet of old letters written by Anne's parents. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits her parents' grave and reads the letters, feeling for the first time that she truly knows them.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday
